scoutNote.city: Your scouts fight the city's scouts (a hero helps). If any survive, the report shows its resources, troops, fortifications and loyalty; Informatics adds heroes (level 1) and buildings (level 2). If none survive, you learn nothing.
scoutNote.npc: Barbarian cities never stop scouts: one is enough. The report shows their troops, fortifications, walls, resources, loyalty, buildings and hero.
scoutNote.valley: Valleys never stop scouts: one is enough. The report shows the troops guarding it and who holds it.
scoutNote.other: Only scouts go on a scouting mission.
